{{Top|leg}}
The '''agrinium grip''' was an enhanced [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] for bladed weapons that was made from the mineral [[agrinium]]. The lightness of the mineral balanced the weapon towards the point, allowing for more a more powerful swing and thus, deeply penetrating injuries. This grip had been available in two versions, advanced and superior.
